Azimlib visual identity

The wordmark and 2048-pixel globe are the preferred assets for project presentations. The 110-pixel and 32-pixel icons have thicker grids and arrows for small displays; they are distinct compositions, not simple reductions.

Asset Intended use
Wordmark README and horizontal presentations
2048-pixel globe Large presentations and artwork
110-pixel icon Compact project cards
32-pixel icon Small icons

All PNGs retain their original transparent backgrounds. The source images are preserved byte for byte, with sizes and hashes in the manifest. Original visual compositions: Copyright (c) 2026 Kernerian, BSD-3-Clause. The globe geometry uses Natural Earth public-domain data, rendered by Azimlib. The underlying data remains governed by its own terms; see third-party notices. No Matplotlib logo, icon, artwork or implementation is included.

Wordmark typography

The lettering uses Carlito Bold Italic, designed by Łukasz Dziedzic, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Upstream, license reference, official artwork FAQ. This is a voluntary acknowledgement of the design tool. These PNGs contain rasterized lettering, not redistributed font software. The OFL does not require artwork to use OFL or carry a credit; the original composition remains under its stated BSD terms. No Carlito TTF/OTF/WOFF or font source is shipped. The exact font binary/version used to make the wordmark was not retained; this inventory does not invent a binary hash or transfer font copyright. Any future distribution/embedding of the font must preserve its actual copyright, OFL text and Reserved Font Name declaration. The current upstream reference names the Carlito Project Authors and reserves the name Carlito.

Original code/compositions: BSD 3-Clause · Kernerian. Third-party notices. Source.
